runners_data.name: Parisian Scholar
runners_data.note: Won twice over 12f at Goodwood on form and is proven at the trip, but ran just two days ago — the rapid turnaround from Charlie Johnston's yard is the headline concern; Jason Hart rides and the horse's hold-up style needs a searching gallop to land a blow.
runners_data.comment: Parisian Scholar arrives on the back of back-to-back wins and 20 days' rest suggesting he's in good heart, and he has experience over today's trip and conditions; however, a rating of 90 ranked seventh of fourteen hints at stiff company here.

runners_data.name: Magnatura
runners_data.note: Tom Ward's 3yo has a visor on and is a natural front-runner or prominent racer by inclination, but the field's crowded pace section means he is likely squeezed away from his preferred berth — Shoemark's yard has had zero winners from nine in the last 14 days, which adds a trainers'-form concern.
runners_data.comment: Ran a solid third last time out and has experience of today's trip and going, but his recent form also features three finishes outside the placings in his last five starts — the 125 lb burden from stall one adds another question mark for this midfield contender.

runners_data.name: Kenergy
runners_data.note: Unproven on Good to Firm (all three career starts at Sandown on softer) and his running style is unclear — George Baker's horse is the least exposed here in terms of going evidence and the step to 1m3f is an unknown quantity.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last three starts and ranked last on our figures, Kenergy looks a tough sell here; he was third two starts back but otherwise has posted fourth-place finishes, and a four-point gap between his official mark and our rating underlines the concern.

runners_data.name: Mythical Valentine
runners_data.note: Oisin Murphy picks up a horse with solid 12f Goodwood form (won and placed), but her natural hold-up inclination means the field's density has pushed her further back than she'd like — Murphy's presence gives her residual claims if the race develops late.
runners_data.comment: Ranked 13 of 14 on our figures, Mythical Valentine makes his case hard to press despite a win two starts back and a third last time out; he has run over today's trip and going before, but with 124 lb from stall 7, the numbers simply don't flatter him.

runners_data.name: Astracornus
runners_data.note: David Menuisier's 3yo won over 10f at Goodwood last time and handles similar going well, but her natural finishing style has been displaced rearward by the field's structure — the trainer has had no winners in the past 14 days and she must hope for a true pace to unlock her run.
runners_data.comment: Astracornus won two starts back and was second last time out, giving him back-to-back positives to build on, though he's been beaten well in three of his last five starts; has run over today's trip and going, and 119 lb from stall 14 are the questions here.

races.paceDynamic: Silver State is the lone confirmed front-runner and, with no genuine challenger for the lead in a 14-runner field over 1m3f on Good to Firm ground at Goodwood, she is set to bowl along at a sustainable, uncontested gallop that could be deceptively modest in tempo. Pearl River, Pierian, Into The Light, and Steel Raven will contest the prominent positions just behind, creating a compact early bunch rather than a searching pace, which tilts the shape toward those racing handily. The field carries more naturally prominent types than the race map can accommodate — Magnatura and Mythical Valentine are most likely to actually secure their preferred forward positions, while Astracornus is likely to be shuffled back from her true running style. With a controlled pace set by a lone leader and an influential cluster of prominent types likely to travel into the race comfortably, this shape strongly favours horses racing in the first half of the field who can quicken off a moderate tempo — hold-up horses will need an acceleration they may not get.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Controls Race
scenarios.trigger: If Silver State dictates an uncontested, moderate pace that fails to truly stress the prominent brigade.
scenarios.body: Silver State sets a comfortable tempo into Goodwood's straight, and the horses racing prominently just behind — Pierian, Pearl River, and Into The Light — travel sweetly before unleashing finishing kicks that a compressed field of hold-up horses cannot match.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Quicken, Hold-Up Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens sufficiently in the final three furlongs to string the field out and allow genuine finishers to close.
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop suddenly lifts turning for home as the prominent pack jockey for position, creating enough of a test that hold-up horses with class — Devil's Peak and Waterford Castle — can pick off tiring rivals late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Silver State is allowed such an easy time of it that she simply outstays the field from the front.
scenarios.body: With no pressure applied and her rider riding a perfectly judged race, Silver State converts her race-shaping role into a genuine winning chance, with Pierian and Pearl River closest in pursuit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos, Compression, Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack set a strong enough pace that the race develops into a true stamina test favouring improvers off the pace.
scenarios.body: A faster-than-expected gallop set by multiple prominent runners stringing the race out suits late closers who get a clear run in the straight, with Devil's Peak's most recent Goodwood win a live reference.

watchPoints.text: Silver State's early pace — if Rose Dawes allows a crawl in the first half mile, the entire race shape collapses into a sprint that advantages prominent types like Pierian and Pearl River over all hold-up runners.

Pierian's sectionals turning for home — this horse has won twice at Goodwood over the trip and Tom Marquand will look to make smooth headway early in the straight; if he gets a clear passage he could go clear quickly in this moderate-pace scenario.

Devil's Peak's run timing — James Doyle must decide when to deliver this hold-up performer given the likely compressed mid-race pace; if he gets tight on the rail at the two-furlong pole, his chance evaporates despite his excellent Goodwood record.

Parisian Scholar's two-day turnaround — Charlie Johnston's horse ran just 48 hours ago and while the horse is in form, handlers and bettors should monitor market moves; unusual quick reappearance at a major track sometimes signals confidence or necessity.

Magnatura and Mythical Valentine at the start — watch whether either secures a position more forward than the map suggests; if Magnatura hustles out and gets close to Silver State, the race shape and scenario probabilities shift meaningfully.

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Wisper
runners_data.note: Eight-year-old hold-up specialist with strong Goodwood course form at 1m2f including a win and a place here; David Egan rides a horse at home on this track, but her natural off-the-pace style needs a truly run race to make ground, and a single uncontested front-runner risks the pace being insufficient to open the gaps she requires.
runners_data.comment: Wisper arrives here on the back of a win two starts back and a placed effort last time out, and she has experience of today's trip and conditions — her 92 rating suggests she holds strong claims, though the 138 lb burden is the obvious threat to her chances.

runners_data.name: Lady Dora Mae
runners_data.note: Three-year-old with excellent recent Goodwood course form including a win over 1m and multiple placed efforts on similar ground; Billy Loughnane's mount has the tactical versatility to sit just behind Silver Lake and is weighted as one of the most likely beneficiaries if the pace is controlled and the race is settled in the last two furlongs.
runners_data.comment: Lady Dora Mae arrives here in solid heart, back-to-back second-place finishes two and three starts back bookending a win four starts back, and she has experience over today's distance and going — the chief concern is whether that sixth last time out signals a dip in form.

runners_data.name: Zgharta
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding's four-year-old has a natural inclination to race prominently, but with Lady Dora Mae, Folk Pageant, and Spinning Lizzie all likely to claim the handy positions first, Oisin Murphy may find himself unable to secure that pitch and forced wider than ideal; the style-fit discount applies and tempers her chance unless rivals struggle for room.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts, Zgharta nonetheless rates joint-top on our figures and has experience of today's trip and conditions; drawn in stall seven carrying 135 lb, she sets the standard here.

runners_data.name: Spinning Lizzie
runners_data.note: Kieran Shoemark partners a three-year-old who has finished third at Goodwood over 1m and shows a consistent prominent profile; her course form is solid on this surface and she is one of the runners most naturally suited to travelling in the first four here, though she steps up markedly in trip from her recent Goodwood starts.
runners_data.comment: Spinning Lizzie arrives here on the back of a third three starts back and experience over today's trip and going, with her 97 rating suggesting she's nicely treated off 94; the concern is that her last two runs have yielded a fifth and an unplaced effort.

runners_data.name: Folk Pageant
runners_data.note: Hector Crouch rides a Goodwood-course-familiar three-year-old who has won twice on Good to Firm-type ground and finished fifth here over 1m3f most recently; Charlie Johnston's filly has a legitimate claim to a prominent position and her two wins at this trip on similar going make the step to 1m2f at Goodwood a reasonable fit, though her recent handicap form has been patchy.

runners_data.name: Room Fourteen
runners_data.note: Ryan Moore partners a three-year-old with an impressive record of three wins and a second across her last four starts, all at 1m on Goodwood's flat course; she is a genuinely front-running or prominent type by nature, but with multiple rivals contesting those spots, Moore may have to exercise patience from a position further back than this filly typically occupies — that constraint, not her ability, is the key variable.
runners_data.comment: Room Fourteen arrives in decent nick — a winner two starts back and three wins in her last five — but she ranks sixth of seven on our figures, with a speed rating that leaves plenty to find on these terms.

runners_data.name: Silver Lake
runners_data.note: William Haggas's three-year-old is the lone confirmed front-runner and won over 1m on Good to Firm ground at Goodwood last time; Saffie Osborne can set her own terms and dictate the pace from the front, and with no obvious rival likely to contest the lead, she has the significant tactical advantage of racing precisely how she wants — the question is purely whether her raw ability matches her positional advantage over 1m2f.
runners_data.comment: Silver Lake won last time out to arrive here in form, and she has experience of today's trip and conditions — but ranked last on our figures, there is a significant gap to bridge against this field.

races.paceDynamic: Silver Lake is the lone confirmed front-runner and, with only one horse genuinely likely to lead, she will set a controlled, uncontested pace on Good to Firm ground over 1m2f at Goodwood — a shape that historically rewards horses who can travel smoothly close to that rhythm. Lady Dora Mae and Folk Pageant are the natural prominent types most likely to occupy the positions directly behind Silver Lake, with Spinning Lizzie also capable of sitting handy. The field contains more prominent-minded runners than the race shape can accommodate: Zgharta and Room Fourteen are both true prominent types but are mapped to midfield because Lady Dora Mae, Folk Pageant, and Spinning Lizzie are all likely to edge them out of their preferred slots. With a single uncontested pace-setter dictating a sustainable gallop and the prominent berths settled early, this race shape strongly favours horses who can travel in the first three or four, conserve energy through the middle portion, and produce a controlled turn-of-foot in the final two furlongs — the prominent-to-midfield profile benefits most, while genuine hold-up horses like Wisper face the risk of a tempo that never truly stretches the field enough to make up ground from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Types Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Silver Lake controls the pace at a fair but unexacting tempo and the prominent horses travel within striking range throughout.
scenarios.body: Lady Dora Mae, Folk Pageant, and Spinning Lizzie slot in directly behind Silver Lake and deliver their finishing efforts from positions of comfort, with the race decided in the final two furlongs between horses who never had to fight for cover; this scenario strongly suits horses with both the class and the Goodwood course form to quicken on fast ground from a handy pitch.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Silver Lake Gallops Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Silver Lake is allowed to bowl along unchallenged and the pace proves too hot for hold-up horses to reel in.
scenarios.body: With no rival willing to press her, Silver Lake extends her advantage through the home turn and the lack of sustained pressure from the back makes her increasingly hard to catch; the race then favours a horse with the jumping ability off a moderate pace to close, but Silver Lake's own improvement bar on this surface and trip becomes the central question.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace turns genuinely strong due to tactical jostling among the prominent types and creates a true gallop that stretches the field.
scenarios.body: Wisper, racing from the back as her natural style dictates, benefits if the gap between pace-setters and closers opens up, and her Goodwood course form over the same distance gives her a credible window; the scenario is somewhat constrained because Wisper needs a faster pace than a single uncontested front-runner typically generates.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Squeeze Plays Out
scenarios.trigger: If the redistributed horses Zgharta and Room Fourteen are shuffled back and unable to recover their natural prominent position in time.
scenarios.body: Racing out of their preferred role, both Zgharta and Room Fourteen would need the pace to collapse late and a weakening front rank to capitalise, which is an unlikely combination given Silver Lake's uncontested lead; their reduced style-fit scores temper any expectation that this scenario delivers, and the probability is weighted accordingly.

watchPoints.text: Silver Lake — if she is allowed to steal a march uncontested and the gallop is softer than it appears, horses chasing from midfield or behind may simply not have enough racing room or pace to close her down in the final two furlongs.

Room Fourteen — Ryan Moore will be aware his filly wants to be prominent but may be squeezed for that position by Lady Dora Mae, Spinning Lizzie, and Folk Pageant early, so watch her position at the first furlong as a guide to whether she is in her comfort zone or already compromised.

Wisper — her chance is almost entirely pace-dependent; if Silver Lake dictates a steady fractions-based gallop, watch for Wisper to be held up but unable to quicken past a wall of horses who have conserved energy from handy positions.

Zgharta — Oisin Murphy may attempt to push forward from the widest draw to claim a prominent berth, which could briefly spike the pace in the early stages; if he commits to it, the reshuffle of positions through the first quarter-mile is worth tracking for its knock-on effect on Room Fourteen and Spinning Lizzie.

Lady Dora Mae — Billy Loughnane's positioning in the first half-mile will be instructive; if she travels directly behind Silver Lake with cover, she is in the ideal box-seat and the race shape plays squarely into her hands based on her recent Goodwood course form.
